dmWelcome.greeting: Hey, glad you messaged. Here is a quick look inside Balance so you can actually see what I mean.
dmWelcome.offerMessage: Balance brings your weekly plan, plant-based nutrition, progress, learning and community into one place. The Founders Pass is AU$99 once. You get six weeks of one-to-one in-app support with me, then lifetime access to the core app and plant-based community.
dmWelcome.followUpExpectation: Shannon will reply here and help you work out the best next step.
dmWelcome.rule: Do not configure visible quick-reply buttons in the Meta messaging template. Let the lead type naturally, answer their actual sentence directly, and use one statement-led follow-up only when it changes the next move. Use the app preview on the first ad-attributed enquiry and send the checkout URL immediately when the person asks for the link or says they are ready.

decisionRules: Do not edit during the first 72 hours unless delivery or tracking is broken.
After 72 hours, pause an ad only when it has spent at least 1.5 times the account median cost per conversation without a conversation.
Keep the two best ads by qualified conversation rate, not cheapest clicks.
Scale the winning ad set by no more than 20 percent every 48 hours.
